summary: BlackBerry filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that QNX and Vector Informatik announced the first design win for Alloy Kore, their jointly developed foundational vehicle OS. The win, with Coretura, the software-defined vehicle platform company founded by Daimler Truck and Volvo Group, adds over $100 million to QNX royalty backlog and is the largest design win in QNX history. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics apply. Watch actual production volumes and termination risk against management's backlog estimate.
